input.goal: Pulse all the dressing ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth.

sub_goals.text: Test the blender and prepare the avocado
Weigh and add the avocado to the canister
Retrieve and add greek yoghurt to the canister
Add water and parsley to the canister
Prepare and add garlic to the canister
Add salt and blend the dressing ingredients

plan.goal: Pulse all the dressing ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth.

events.description: The person presses a button on the blender base to test it.
events.relevance: ensures the equipment works before adding ingredients

events.description: A brief whirring sound of the blender motor is heard.
The person cuts the avocado in half with a knife.
events.relevance: prepares the avocado to be scooped

events.description: The blender canister is placed onto a kitchen scale.
events.relevance: allows the avocado to be weighed as it is added

events.description: The person scoops the avocado flesh out of its skin and drops it into the canister.
events.relevance: adds the first ingredient to the blender

events.description: The person scoops greek yoghurt from a container into the canister.
events.relevance: adds the second ingredient to the blender

events.description: The person pours water from a cup into the canister.
events.relevance: adds liquid to help the dressing blend smoothly

events.description: The person places fresh parsley into the canister.
events.relevance: adds herbs to the dressing mixture

events.description: The person peels and chops a clove of garlic on the cutting board.
events.relevance: prepares the garlic so it blends evenly

events.description: The person drops the prepared garlic pieces into the canister.
events.relevance: adds the garlic to the dressing mixture

events.description: The person sprinkles salt into the canister.
The lid is securely placed and locked onto the canister.
events.relevance: prevents ingredients from spilling during blending

events.description: The person presses the pulse button on the blender.
A loud, continuous whirring sound of the blender processing the ingredients is heard.
events.relevance: indicates the ingredients are actively being blended

relations.ask: What specific item is being scooped into the canister?
relations.answer_hint: It is the avocado that was cut open in the previous step.

decision_points.why: The person must decide to transition from preparing the avocado to actively measuring and adding it to the blender.
The person must choose which ingredient to retrieve and add next (yoghurt) from the available recipe items.
The person must decide to add the next specific ingredients (water and parsley) to the mixture.
The person must decide to switch from adding ready ingredients to preparing a new raw ingredient (garlic) before adding it.
The person must decide that all main ingredients are in, add the final seasoning (salt), and transition to the blending phase.
The person must visually assess the texture of the dressing and decide when it is 'mostly smooth' to stop pulsing.
